findings.claim: With the explicitly added 1:5 act of exclusive worship beside it, the focus's repeated divine name can also be heard as the named object toward which the remembering, guarding, and covenant response is directed.
findings.mechanism: The focus Allah occurrences carry the supplied worship-and-worshiped-being facet, while the external 1:5 worship occurrence supplies a separate act; their contact returns through the focus name and gives its commands an explicit worship relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus commands become perceptible within an active worshiping relationship, not as detached recollection or caution.
findings.containment: This overlay identifies a local contact with the explicitly supplied 1:5 act; it does not announce a whole-Fatiha system or replace the focus covenant and favor readings.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch is supplied and accepted, and the external worship occurrence is exact, but the external unit is a lean context projection without a reviewed support record for this contact.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus response is heard within worship directed to the named divine object.
branch_activations.boundary: The overlay does not make every use of the divine name a separate worship formula or make the focus a quotation of 1:5.

findings.title: Interior knowledge within the created whole
findings.claim: The explicitly added 1:2 occurrence of al-ʿālamīn expands the scope around the focus's knowledge of chests: the inner contents named here become a specified interior reach within the created whole.
findings.mechanism: The external al-ʿālamīn occurrence carries the supplied created-world facet under the focus root, while the focus ʿalīm and chest occurrences provide the knowing relation and its interior domain; the same-root contact returns through the focus knowledge word.
findings.reader_payoff: The final knowledge assertion is perceived with both scale and precision: a whole created scope and a close interior are held in one relation.
findings.containment: The overlay adds scope to the focus knowledge clause; it does not turn the focus into a whole-surah claim about divine knowledge or activate every available world-related branch.

epistemic.reason: The created-world branch is accepted in the focus registry and the external occurrence is exact, but the external context is lean and no dedicated reviewed support record establishes this overlay.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Evren ve içindeki yaratılmış varlıkların tamamı tek bir bütün olarak adlandırılır.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: What is within chests is seen as a particular inward reach of knowledge extending across the created whole.
branch_activations.boundary: The overlay does not claim that the focus word simply means worlds or that every created thing is separately enumerated here.

findings.title: Favor opened as provision
findings.claim: The explicitly added 1:2 sustainer-and-worlds phrase opens a water-provision image in the focus knowledge word, allowing the remembered favor to be perceived as provision held for the created whole.
findings.mechanism: The focus ʿalīm occurrence carries the supplied water-rich-well facet, while external Rabb and al-ʿālamīn occurrences provide the independent sustainer and world-scope triggers; their contact returns through the focus favor and knowledge words.
findings.reader_payoff: The favor named at the opening gains a material sustaining shape: provision is pictured as gathered and held for those within the sustainer's world.
findings.containment: The water image is a bounded two-word external overlay; it does not claim the full Fatiha water system, merge sea and well into one object, or replace the ordinary favor reading.

epistemic.reason: The water branch is marked reframed in the focus registry and the external trigger surfaces are lean; the contact is retained as an exploratory overlay with its branch distinction visible.

branch_activations.boundary: The branch records sea and water-rich well as separate source variants; only the water-rich-well facet is used, and no complete water channel is asserted.

findings.title: Knowledge as a waymark contact
findings.claim: The explicitly added 1:2 world occurrence together with the 1:6 guidance and straight-road phrase gives the focus knowledge word a local waymark resonance: the known signs make a route distinguishable and findable.
findings.mechanism: The focus ʿalīm occurrence carries the qualified distinguishing-and-wayfinding-sign facet; external al-ʿālamīn supplies the sign-bearing world contact and 1:6 supplies guidance, road, and straightness as the independent route trigger, with the reading returning through the focus knowledge word.
findings.reader_payoff: The final knowledge clause can be perceived as more than passive information: it has the capacity to distinguish what is before the traveler and make a route legible while preserving the focus's claim about inner contents.
findings.containment: This is a local external overlay through the focus word; it does not name a mature Fatiha path system, turn 5:7 into a path request, or replace knowledge of chests with guidance language.

epistemic.reason: The focus sign branch is qualified and the external route surfaces are lean; the explicit carrier, route trigger, and focus return support an exploratory rather than grounded overlay.
